_prune_cache() {
  local dir=$1
  local budget_kb=$2
  [[ -d $dir ]] || return 0
  
  local total
  total=$(du -sk -- "$dir" | cut -f1)
  
  local mtime_file
  mtime_file=$(mktemp) || return 0
  
  find "$dir" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    local mtime
    mtime=$(stat -f %m "$f" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y "$f" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '%s %s\n' "$mtime" "$f" >> "$mtime_file"
  done
  
  sort -n "$mtime_file" | cut -d' ' -f2- | while IFS= read -r f; do
    (( total <= budget_kb )) && break
    
    local sz
    sz=$(du -sk -- "$dir/$f" | cut -f1)
    rm -rf -- "$dir/$f"
    total=$(( total - sz ))
  done
  
  rm -f "$mtime_file"
}
